final_answer_text:
Both runs completed successfully. Results:

| Vehicle | Plant | Completion time | Propulsion energy |
|---|---|---|---|
| **vehicle-a-otter** | planar3 | 10.1 s (reached waypoint early) | **5.343** |
| vehicle-c-azimuth | coupled6 | 36.8 s (reached waypoint early) | 8.578 |

**vehicle-a-otter (planar3) used less propulsion energy** — 5.34 vs. 8.58 for vehicle-c-azimuth (coupled6), about 38% less. Note both runs finished the 30 m waypoint mission well before the nominal 60 s duration was up (10.1 s vs 36.8 s elapsed), so the comparison reflects the full mission-completion energy in each case, not a truncated partial run.
detail: expected vehicle-a-otter to use less propulsion energy
